hq_location.notes: The company profile lists headquarters in San Francisco, California; the company record identifies the country as the United States.

public_docs.notes: The public site presents product and marketing pages, but no public multi-article help center or developer documentation portal was found.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent funding round supported by the company’s dated announcement is October 2024, before the 18-month window starting May 9, 2025.

founded_year.notes: The company’s 2025 newsroom article states it was founded in 2015; a LinkedIn profile gives a conflicting year, so this uses the dated company statement.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $30M first external round in October 2024 ($20M equity and $10M debt); PitchBook classifies the $30M deal as Series A. Later third-party entries were not corroborated by company announcements.

launched_6mo.notes: The newsroom index’s newest product launch shown is Nexus, dated April 14, 2026, before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage directs visitors to talk to sales; the reviewed pricing research reports no public pricing page or published prices.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook lists 175 employees, placing the company in the 101-200 band; LinkedIn gives a broader 51-200 range.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive posting is listed.

model_provider.notes: The product says it uses multiple LLM foundation models, but the reviewed public product/trust/blog material does not name a model provider.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in interface.ai customer case-study listings.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Applied AI Engineer posting is listed.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, and GDPR; no HIPAA or PCI DSS claim was included.
